title: Clean historical audit corpus and add local audit intelligence

requirements.text: Provide a deterministic local pipeline that cleans, deduplicates, severity-normalizes and taxonomy-labels the third-party audit corpus.
Do not persist PoC/exploit code in the cleaned Historical Audit Intelligence corpus.
Attach bounded historical analogue context to verified-source and structural findings when a local cleaned corpus is configured.
Provide a local vulnerability-category classifier, similarity engine, historical review-priority model and deterministic holdout evaluation.
Expand verified-source review vocabulary with token-accounting, permit/replay, cross-chain, liquidation/solvency and MEV/slippage surfaces.
Historical intelligence must remain optional and the normal scanner must work when no corpus is installed.
Generated third-party corpus files must not be committed or bundled into installers while redistribution/commercial-use rights are unresolved.
Historical similarity and risk context must never be represented as vulnerability proof or exploitability percentage.

acceptance.text: npm run check succeeds with the audit-intelligence regression included.
Cleaner metadata records local-only licensing constraints and proofOfConceptContentRetained=false.
Regression evidence proves historical output contains no PoC field/code and verified-source inspection remains truthful about evidence limitations.
No third-party dataset payload is added to Git history or Electron build files.

quality_gates.performance: bounded corpus <=96MB at runtime; max 100k records; max 32 current findings and 3 analogues per finding
quality_gates.privacy: local corpus only; no remote model inference; PoC content discarded
quality_gates.licensing: unverified third-party corpus is never bundled
